Weekly road closures are in place for major restoration work. The Oxley Highway will be closed between Knodingbul and Forbes River Roads at the following dates and times:

  • Each Tuesday to Thursday from 7am to 4:30pm
  • Each Friday from 7am to 3pm

The highway will remain open for special event exceptions on the following dates:

  • 14 March (Walcha Agricultural Show)

The highway will also remain open on weekends, Mondays, school holidays and public holidays.

The weekly road closures will be in place from 4 February to 31 July, 2025.

Traffic controllers will be on site to direct motorists. Portable traffic lights will allow motorists to pass in one direction at a time. Motorists are advised to allow approximately 5 minutes of additional travel time.

Westbound traffic will be diverted during work hours. All traffic to be detoured during full closures.

April full closures: 1-3, 6-10, 14-16, 22-23 and 28-29.
